Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Education has been renamed Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Engineering (HCM-UTE) under Decision No. 2809/QĐ-TTg issued by the Prime Minister.
STUDENT MOBILITY
HCM-UTE Student Experiences One Month in Japan through GO JAPAN 2026
(21/08/2026)
An HCM-UTE student had the opportunity to participate in
GO JAPAN 2026
, spending one month in Japan for study, internship, and cultural experiences. The program included Japanese language classes, an internship at
FPT Japan Holdings
, and opportunities to experience everyday life and culture in Japan.
HCM-UTE – Mahasarakham University (Thailand) Academic Exchange Program Concludes with Research for Sustainable Development
(19/07/2026)
As part of the international cooperation program between Ho Chi Minh
City University of Technology and Engineering (HCM-UTE, formerly Ho Chi
Minh City University of Technology and Education) and Mahasarakham
University (MSU), Thailand, the Faculty of Foreign Languages at HCM-UTE,
in collaboration with several academic faculties, organized an academic
exchange program for 30 students from Mahasarakham University from July
6–9, 2026.
Launching the Southeast Asia Peer Learning Program: HCM-UTE Welcomes MSU-GSC Students
(01/06/2026)
The one-month journey of internship and cultural immersion for Filipino students at HCM-UTE has officially begun, promising to foster meaningful academic collaborations and lifelong cross-border friendships.
HCM-UTE and British United College (BUC) Myanmar Promote ASEAN Student Connectivity through the 2026 International Exchange Programme
(28/05/2026)
On May 13, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Engineering (HCM-UTE) collaborated with British United College (BUC), Myanmar, to organize the “Vietnam - Myanmar Student Exchange Programme 2026: HCM-UTE x BUC.
[Student Stories] – A Semester To Remember: From HCM-UTE To Politechnika Krakowska
(20/03/2026)
"One of the most meaningful experiences of my life!" – That is how our student describes their incredible exchange journey at the Faculty of Computer Science and Mathematics, Politechnika Krakowska (Cracow University of Technology), Poland.
Pack Your Youth Into A Journey To Incheon (INU)
(20/03/2026)
Have you ever wondered what a semester in the Land of the Morning Calm truly feels like? Let’s hear the stories from our "seniors" about their incredible journey at Incheon National University (INU)
HCMUTE Student Explores AIRVENTURE 2025
(05/09/2025)
A student majoring in Furniture and Wood Technology in the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering at Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Education (HCMUTE), spent an exciting and meaningful summer at the AUN Summer Camp: Airlangga Adventure (AIRVENTURE) 2025 in Indonesia.
Limoges — The Heart Of France, Now Forever In Mine
(28/07/2025)
“Limoges has opened a brand-new chapter in the journey of my life — it’s not just at the heart of France, but forever in the heart of mine.”
NCU 2024 Summer Program
(16/07/2024)
From June 16th to July 20th, 2024, the National Central University (NCU), Taiwan, has welcomed three HCMUTE students.
The Summer Internship Program 2024 of NYCU
(15/08/2024)
From July 1st to July 12th, 2024, the National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), Taiwan, has received two HCMUTE students - one from the Faculty of Electrical and Electronics Engineering and one from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering - this exchange activity is under the Summer Internship Program 2024 of NYCU.
